name: get_microfrontends_config_for_project
description:
Get the microfrontends config for a project by ID or name.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/microfrontends/projects/{projectIdOrName}/production-mfe-config --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

projectIdOrName.description: The name or ID of the project

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
